body.description:
## Changelog   
### ✨ Features   
* c81a40c8: feat(df): add package command to check a single PURL (Michael Eddington <meddington@gitlab.com>)   
* cd957b0d: feat(mcp): close annotation coverage gaps and add coverage test (James Hebden <jhebden@gitlab.com>)   
* 6d7a7473: feat(stack): add a command to delete a stack (Maksym Tymoshyk <maksym.tymoshyk@gmail.com>)   
* 9ae8b354: feat(stack): properly update branches on stack reorder and add guards rebase in-progress (Casey Morris <caseymorris61@gmail.com>)   
* 0a2765c7: feat(telemetry): distinguish MCP tool calls from direct CLI use (Kai Armstrong <karmstrong@gitlab.com>)   
* d5dde305: feat: delegate path ownership to domain teams without Maintainer (Kai Armstrong <karmstrong@gitlab.com>)   
* b20fb66d: feat: mr note create support for internal notes/threads (Giannis Kepas <contact@gkepas.com>)   
### 🐛 Bug Fixes   
* 6df4dae4: fix(issue): reject invalid list output flags (Mahidul Haque <mahidulhaqalif@gmail.com>)   
* cb7c3eb5: fix(mr): fast-forward a checked-out branch on repeat checkout (Jeston Singh <sjestonsingh@gmail.com>)   
* f1a933b9: fix(orbit): require Orbit CLI 0.130.0 so setup picks your agents (Jean-Gabriel Doyon <jgdoyon@gitlab.com>)   
* c9b48d28: fix: cmd/glab tests fail under goleak (Syed Saif Ali Alvi <saifalialvi@gmail.com>)   
### 📝 Documentation   
* 7b5192e7: docs(agents): drop the removed gen-config command (Kai Armstrong <karmstrong@gitlab.com>)   
* 00edd69e: docs(skills): add contributing section to bundled glab skill (Dmitry Gruzd <dgruzd@gitlab.com>)   
### 📦 Dependencies   
* 008bcb03: chore(deps): update dependency @commitlint/cli to ^21.2.3 (GitLab Renovate Bot <gitlab-bot@gitlab.com>)   
* 542d54c2: chore(deps): update dependency @commitlint/config-conventional to ^21.2.3 (GitLab Renovate Bot <gitlab-bot@gitlab.com>)   
* 77a8e92e: chore(deps): update dependency @commitlint/format to ^21.2.3 (GitLab Renovate Bot <gitlab-bot@gitlab.com>)   
* 93f95503: chore(deps): update dependency @commitlint/lint to ^21.2.3 (GitLab Renovate Bot <gitlab-bot@gitlab.com>)   
* 9b8d080c: chore(deps): update dependency @commitlint/read to ^21.2.3 (GitLab Renovate Bot <gitlab-bot@gitlab.com>)   
* 8446d1de: chore(deps): update dependency markdownlint-cli2 to v0.23.3 (GitLab Renovate Bot <gitlab-bot@gitlab.com>)   
* cee1c145: chore(deps): update module github.com/dustin/go-humanize to v1.1.0 (GitLab Renovate Bot <gitlab-bot@gitlab.com>)   
* 5c3f65ad: chore(deps): update module gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go/v3 to v3.14.0 (GitLab Renovate Bot <gitlab-bot@gitlab.com>)   
* ad728cd0: chore(deps): update module gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go/v3 to v3.15.0 (GitLab Renovate Bot <gitlab-bot@gitlab.com>)   
### 🔧 Maintenance   
* 32512e34: chore: add tw-docops CODEOWNERS for docs lint config (Marcel Amirault <mamirault@gitlab.com>)   
* 729129ac: refactor: remove the custom --project and --hostname flag pair (Jean van der Walt <jvanderwalt@gitlab.com>)   
### 🔀 Others   
* f91498fc: test(mr): scope the mr note publish integration test to API contract (Kai Armstrong <karmstrong@gitlab.com>)
